us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Campaigning intensifies two weeks before US midterm elections
bullets: Election Day is two weeks away, on November 3.
NPR reported campaigns are entering a final high-intensity stretch.
Voters are weighing Congress amid war, prices and domestic policy fights.

articles.title: Justice Department charges 28 people in California voting-crimes case
bullets: NPR’s morning brief listed DOJ voting-crime charges in California.
The case comes during the final midterm campaign stretch.
Details were reported as part of Tuesday’s national news roundup.

articles.title: DHS grants temporary deportation reprieve to Ukrainians and Sudanese
bullets: More than 100,000 Ukrainians and Sudanese are covered.
Their US protection had been set to expire Monday.
DHS action temporarily reduces immediate deportation risk.

articles.title: Mahmoud Khalil asks Supreme Court to speed review of immigration detentions
bullets: Khalil asked justices to allow faster judicial review.
The case concerns immigration-related detention challenges.
He framed the appeal as broader than his own case.

articles.title: Trump orders expanded federal research into women’s health
bullets: The order directs agencies to bolster women’s health research.
It covers health across stages of women’s lives.
The plan was backed by first lady Melania Trump.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Russian aerial attacks kill seven in Ukraine as Zelenskyy visits Norway
bullets: Russia launched a major aerial blitz on Ukraine.
AP reported at least seven people were killed.
Zelenskyy met US and European officials in Norway.

articles.title: Iran accused of prolonging US talks as tensions remain high
bullets: Iranian officials told Reuters talks were being prolonged deliberately.
Officials said Tehran was preparing for renewed attacks.
The report came ahead of US midterm elections.

articles.title: Germany charges three suspects over alleged plot targeting US installations
bullets: Germany’s federal prosecutor filed charges Tuesday.
Two German nationals and one Turkish national were charged.
Authorities allege a plot to bomb US installations.

articles.title: Drone strike in disputed Sudan-South Sudan area kills dozens
bullets: Reuters reported the strike killed dozens of people.
A minister confirmed deaths in the disputed area.
The incident was listed among Tuesday’s global headlines.

articles.title: Indonesia deploys thousands of security officers for Prabowo anniversary protests
bullets: Indonesia planned more than 9,000 security officers.
Protests marked Prabowo’s two years in power.
Reuters listed the deployment in Tuesday’s world headlines.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Rubio and Jaishankar hold Mumbai talks on US-India trade deal
bullets: Marco Rubio met S. Jaishankar in Mumbai.
The talks focused on trade and energy cooperation.
Russian oil purchases remain a key tension point.

articles.title: Trump sanctions waiver may ease India’s Russian-oil concerns
bullets: Reuters said the waiver eases India’s energy concerns.
India is a major importer of Russian oil.
The move may improve prospects for a US-India trade deal.

articles.title: Indian shares fall as banks slide and crude weighs on sentiment
bullets: Nifty 50 fell 1.11% on Monday.
Sensex declined 1.17% to 73,852.90.
Private banks led losses after quarterly earnings.

articles.title: Investors await Jio Platforms’ record Indian IPO
bullets: Jio Platforms’ IPO opens for subscription Wednesday.
Reuters said the deal could raise up to $3.2 billion.
The IPO would be India’s largest to date.

articles.title: West Bengal festival stampede kills at least 19
bullets: The stampede happened during a major Hindu festival.
Officials said at least 19 people died.
The incident occurred in eastern India’s West Bengal state.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Market movers and Wall Street themes

articles.title: US futures dip as AI sell-off returns and oil prices rise
bullets: AP reported US futures were lower Tuesday.
AI-related selling returned to markets.
Oil prices rose sharply, pressuring sentiment.

articles.title: Nasdaq climbs as chip and AI-linked stocks rebound
bullets: Reuters said Nasdaq led Wall Street gains Monday.
Chip and AI-linked stocks bounced after a selloff.
The semiconductor index was on track to snap an eight-day losing streak.

articles.title: Oil surge keeps energy and inflation risks in focus for traders
bullets: Brent crude hovered near a five-month high.
Middle East tensions added a geopolitical risk premium.
Oil strength was a major market driver Tuesday.

articles.title: DeepSeek ban hits AI sentiment across markets
bullets: US agencies banned DeepSeek-related technology from civilian systems.
The move intensified US-China AI tensions.
AI names were among the most-watched market targets.

articles.title: Consumer discretionary leads S&P sectors while utilities lag
bullets: Consumer discretionary gained 2.91% at Monday’s close.
Technology rose 1.09% among S&P sectors.
Utilities fell 1.98%, the weakest sector.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories moving business news

articles.title: Walmart launches $120 membership bundle before holidays
bullets: Walmart introduced a $120 membership bundle.
The offer includes Sam’s Club ahead of holiday shopping.
Reuters listed the launch among Tuesday corporate headlines.

articles.title: Amazon to invest more than €16 billion in Germany next year
bullets: Amazon announced a major Germany investment plan.
Reuters reported the investment exceeds €16 billion.
The move expands Amazon’s European business footprint.

articles.title: Ryanair optimistic Boeing MAX 10 certification will finish in October
bullets: Ryanair expressed optimism on MAX 10 certification.
Reuters listed the update in Tuesday business headlines.
Certification timing remains important for Boeing customers.

articles.title: ABB posts record quarterly orders helped by data-center boom
bullets: ABB reported record quarterly orders.
Data-center demand helped drive the order book.
Reuters listed the update among Tuesday corporate news.

articles.title: Volkswagen’s Xpeng bet struggles to revive China business
bullets: Reuters analyzed Volkswagen’s China strategy with Xpeng.
The partnership has not gone as planned.
China remains a critical market for Volkswagen.

articles.title: China defends DeepSeek after US government-systems ban
bullets: China criticized the US ban on DeepSeek products.
The ban applies to federal civilian agency systems.
The dispute highlights the US-China AI race.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO urges German manufacturers to adopt AI faster
bullets: Jensen Huang addressed German industrial companies.
He said AI can help re-engineer manufacturing models.
Huang said digital technology will not replace heavy industry.

articles.title: Google Cloud outage affects London services, Revolut also down
bullets: Reuters reported Google Cloud services faced a London outage.
Revolut services were also reported down.
The incident affected cloud-dependent digital services.

articles.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million to expand enterprise AI transcription
bullets: Otter.ai closed $320 million in growth financing.
General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund led the financing.
The company plans enterprise and international expansion.

articles.title: Software upgrades consume nearly a third of company IT budgets
bullets: A survey found upgrades take nearly one-third of IT budgets.
Reuters listed the finding in Tuesday tech headlines.
The report points to rising enterprise software maintenance costs.
